title: Merkle Commitments with Poseidon in Rust
summary: A collaborative Rust and arkworks work-in-progress prototype for Poseidon commitments, Merkle roots and membership paths.
contribution: A collaborator wrote the initial core implementation. My later work covers selected Poseidon, tree and proof updates, examples and documentation. The repository history records those later changes; it does not make me the sole author of the prototype.
context: Exploratory cryptographic engineering and learning work using arkworks.

evidenceLinks.label: Commit history at the reviewed revision

limitations: The current threshold check is native rather than zero knowledge.
Parameters are demonstrative rather than production cryptographic parameters.
The prototype is unaudited and must not be treated as production cryptography.
The repository and commit history provide inspectable records, not an independent security or authorship audit.
